metadata.title: ArchipelagoFTL
metadata.author: TheLiloji
metadata.description:
Archipelago randomizer support for FTL, built on Hyperspace.
Play FTL as a slot in an Archipelago multiworld: ships, systems and shop items arrive from the other players' games, and your own checks go out to them. Connect from the main menu. DeathLink, TrapLink and EnergyLink are supported.
Linux only for now. Requires Hyperspace 1.23.1, installed first in the mod load order, AND the Hyperspace library built by this project with the Archipelago network module (Hyperspace.1.6.13.amd64.so from the project release), which replaces the official one. No official Hyperspace release contains the network module yet: with the official library the mod loads, shows its menu and can play offline in solo mode, but cannot connect. See setup_en.md in the project release for the three install steps.
Item and location data adapted from the FTL Manual world by Et0san (MIT). Archipelago logo (c) the Archipelago contributors, MIT. See CREDITS.md.
